name: ✦ AsterMC ✦ · Survival among the stars
description:
AsterMC is a BRAND NEW, Space-themed survival server with factions, economy, OP-enchants, custom skins, custom plugins, and so much more!

Here you will find a community of good people that love to help each other where you can easily find a group of friends to explore, pvp, compete, and grind together with! Come give us a shot, you wont regret it!
